stability_rules: required export names remain stable within stdlib major version 1
result tag numeric identity remains stable within stdlib major version 1
text/data helper meaning remains count-and-presence preserving within stdlib major version 1
helpers may grow additively, but exported families must not move between modules without updating the checked-in contracts
advanced helper family ownership remains tied to objc3.concurrency objc3.keypath and objc3.system within stdlib major version 1
strict-system helper exposure remains profile-gated and must not be widened into core claims without a checked-in contract update

core_semantics.option_unwrap_or: returns value when presence flag is nonzero, otherwise the caller-supplied default
core_semantics.string_view_length: returns the provided unit count unchanged
core_semantics.string_view_prefix_units: returns requested units clamped to the provided unit count and zero floor
core_semantics.byte_span_length: returns the provided byte count unchanged
core_semantics.byte_span_prefix_length: returns requested units clamped to the provided byte count and zero floor
core_semantics.array_count: returns the provided element count unchanged
core_semantics.array_prefix_count: returns requested elements clamped to the provided element count and zero floor
core_semantics.map_entry_value_or: returns value when presence flag is nonzero, otherwise the caller-supplied default

error_semantics.result_is_ok: returns 1 only when tag equals result_ok_tag
error_semantics.option_to_result_tag: maps nonzero presence to result_ok_tag and zero presence to result_err_tag
error_semantics.option_result_shape_diagnostic: returns 0 when option presence matches the provided result tag, otherwise 30601
error_semantics.result_unwrap_or: returns value only when tag equals result_ok_tag, otherwise the caller-supplied default
error_semantics.result_error_or: returns code only when tag equals result_err_tag, otherwise the caller-supplied default
error_semantics.ok_or_code: returns value when nonzero, otherwise the caller-supplied default
error_semantics.or_throw_code: returns value when nonzero, otherwise the caller-supplied default
error_semantics.text_data_shape_diagnostic: returns 0 when unit_count equals byte_count, otherwise 30602

keypath_semantics.component_count: returns root plus offset as the explicit component-count shape
keypath_semantics.text_shape_score: returns component_count plus text_units for canonical text-shape validation
keypath_semantics.text_shape_diagnostic: returns 0 when text_units is at least component_count, otherwise 30603
keypath_semantics.typed_keypath_metadata: preserves root and component counts as the current metadata token shape
keypath_semantics.reflection_interop: must preserve the caller-visible keypath component count and diagnostic behavior across module boundaries
keypath_semantics.runtime_composition_shape: must preserve explicit component counts without inventing ownership or allocation semantics
keypath_semantics.reflection_interop_token: returns component_count when reflected_components is negative, otherwise component_count plus reflected_components
keypath_semantics.runtime_composition_token: returns component_count when imported_components is negative, otherwise component_count plus imported_components

concurrency_semantics.spawn_token: routes structured spawn through objc3_runtime_spawn_task_i32 with task kind 1 and the caller-provided executor tag
concurrency_semantics.child_spawn_token: routes structured child spawn through objc3_runtime_spawn_task_i32 with task kind 1 and the caller-provided executor tag
concurrency_semantics.detached_spawn_token: routes detached spawn through objc3_runtime_spawn_task_i32 with task kind 2 and the caller-provided executor tag
concurrency_semantics.join_status: routes cancellation through objc3_runtime_task_on_cancel_i32 on the supplied executor and non-cancelled completion through objc3_runtime_executor_hop_i32 with the supplied result value and executor tag
concurrency_semantics.task_group_scope_depth: routes scope entry, one FIFO task addition and wait per requested child task through the runtime task-group helper cluster; invalid child counts fail closed through objc3_runtime_cancel_task_group_i32
concurrency_semantics.cancellation_checkpoint: routes cancellation checkpoints through objc3_runtime_cancel_task_group_i32 when flagged and objc3_runtime_task_is_cancelled_i32 otherwise
concurrency_semantics.executor_hop_token: routes executor hops through objc3_runtime_executor_hop_i32 with distinct value and executor-tag operands
concurrency_semantics.actor_mailbox_token: routes actor mailbox binding, enqueue, and drain behavior through the runtime actor mailbox helper cluster with distinct actor-handle and executor-tag operands
concurrency_semantics.family_growth_rule: structured-child-spawn detached-spawn join-and-wait task-group-scope cancellation-observation executor-hop and actor-mailbox helpers may grow additively inside objc3.concurrency
concurrency_semantics.layering_rule: objc3.concurrency may depend only on objc3.core and objc3.errors within stdlib major version 1

system_semantics.resource_token: returns seed plus 4 as the canonical deterministic strict-system resource token
system_semantics.cleanup_token: returns seed plus 4 plus cleanup_count when cleanup_count is nonnegative, otherwise seed plus 4
system_semantics.lifetime_borrow_token: returns seed plus 4 plus borrow_depth when borrow_depth is nonnegative, otherwise seed plus 4
system_semantics.diagnostics_gate_token: returns 30704 when observed_profile is lower than required_profile and 0 otherwise
system_semantics.profile_gate: objc3.system helpers remain gated to Strict System and must not become unconditional Core imports
system_semantics.runtime_composition_hook: strict-system runtime-composition helpers must be explicit profile-gated entrypoints rather than implicit side effects in core helpers
system_semantics.layering_rule: objc3.system may depend on objc3.core objc3.errors objc3.concurrency and objc3.keypath but those modules may not depend on objc3.system

non_goals: runtime-backed string or bytes storage before a checked-in core stdlib contract update
presenting runtime-backed executor or reflection semantics without checked-in helper exports
widening strict-system helpers into always-on core imports
